error.BEUSER_INPUT_INVALID: The BeUser request does not match its admitted journey.
remedy.BEUSER_INPUT_INVALID: Inspect the admitted candidate and journey pins before starting a new request.
error.BEUSER_TARGET_NOT_SANDBOX: BeUser refused a target whose isolated realm and Attempt could not be verified.
remedy.BEUSER_TARGET_NOT_SANDBOX: Keep the result invalid. Reconcile the same Attempt and retained realm custody; do not change to a host target.
error.BEUSER_LIMITS_UNAVAILABLE: A complete finite BeUser limits profile is unavailable.
remedy.BEUSER_LIMITS_UNAVAILABLE: Provide a complete registry profile through the installation owner; missing values do not admit a walk.
error.BEUSER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: No active, authorized model satisfies this BeUser role.
remedy.BEUSER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Inspect the role, active model set and maker evidence. Select an authorized model explicitly.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_UNAVAILABLE: The isolated BeUser terminal driver is unavailable.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_UNAVAILABLE: Inspect the retained realm and packaged driver evidence; do not open a host socket or bypass isolation.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_INVALID: The BeUser terminal observation could not be verified.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_INVALID: Keep the result unknown or invalid and inspect the retained observation before any new action.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_LIMIT: The BeUser terminal reached its pinned limit.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_LIMIT: Inspect the recorded limit and cleanup result. A limit does not authorize an automatic retry.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_BUSY: A BeUser terminal action is still in progress.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_BUSY: Wait for the owned action to settle within its deadline; do not queue a duplicate action.
error.BEUSER_CAPTURE_BLOCKED: BeUser capture is closed for a secret step.
remedy.BEUSER_CAPTURE_BLOCKED: Resume capture only after the trusted harness proves the secret process and descriptors ended.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_EOF: The isolated BeUser terminal process ended.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_EOF: Inspect the process result and cleanup evidence. End of output is not journey acceptance.
error.BACKUP_REALM_SEALED: A sealed BeUser installation cannot be backed up, restored or exported.
remedy.BACKUP_REALM_SEALED: Keep backup-dependent uninstall and restore branches unknown. Do not remove the seal or skip the required backup.

deckent beuser walk --journey <id> --candidate <path> [--scope <id>] [--json]
deckent beuser report [--run <id>] [--scope <id>] [--json]
beuser.help.walk.summary: Walk a pinned journey in an isolated realm.
beuser.help.report.summary: Read a retained BeUser journey report.
beuser.help.walk:
deckent beuser walk --journey <id> --candidate <path> [--scope <id>] [--json] [--lang en|tr]
The installed journey, candidate, policy and finite limits must be verified before work begins. Cancellation retains uncertain cleanup.
beuser.help.report:
deckent beuser report [--run <id>] [--scope <id>] [--json] [--lang en|tr]
Reads the retained report with Run inspection authority. Simulated, uncalibrated; this report does not authorize adoption.
Omitting --run reads this person's latest retained report.
